So calling it inside Iterator.hasNext() breaks the hasNext() contract and will lead to unexpected behavior in production.
Bug_Explanation: In the'showBug' method, the 'hasNext' method is called after 'next' method. This breaks the contract of 'hasNext', which does not have any side effects. So, this could lead to unexpected behavior in production.
